Technology and development

Technology can change productivity, reduce transaction costs, create new forms of employment, and alter access to information. Its effects can therefore extend across firms, households, markets, and public institutions.

Technological change does not necessarily benefit everyone equally. Access to infrastructure, skills, finance, and information can determine who is able to adopt new technologies and who may be left behind.
